intake.does: Checks the upgrade ticket is eligible and that no other run holds it, then opens the run record

compat_check.does: Runs the compatibility check that every service repository of the company runs before it takes a new version of the shared library

planning.does: Turns the library's changelog into a checklist, one item at a time, because today's model drops items of a long changelog when it reads it in one go

publish_plan.does: Posts the upgrade plan on the ticket, so that a person can read it

plan_approval.does: The tech lead of the owning team approves the upgrade plan or sends it back; the team meets every two weeks
plan_approval.judge: the tech lead of the owning team

call_sites.does: Applies the change to each of the forty call sites of the library, one independent change per call site

adapter_rewrite.does: Rewrites the adapter layer in one sitting of up to four hours; when it is cut, it starts again from its beginning and nothing is lost but time

open_pr.does: Pushes the branch and opens a draft pull request linked to the ticket

merge_wait.does: Waits up to ten days for the team to review and merge the pull request

backfill.does: Checks the merge is the one reviewed, then rewrites three years of stored records to the new format, batch after batch over several days; no batch may be applied twice, so after a cut it must go on from the batch it had reached

backfill_sign_off.does: The product owner approves the backfill on the strength of its log: forty thousand lines of record identifiers

closing.does: Checks the records are still in the new format, then closes the ticket and records the outcome and the cost
